question: What totality is claimed with respect to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs and their field group?
premises: All earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs are posited as a class.
A total field group belonging to them is posited.
Both are presented together as a single totality.
inference: The verse presents the total field group of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs as a complete set.
uncertainties: The relation between the yoginīs and the field group is not syntactically explicit from these two tokens alone.
plain_english: The whole field group of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
